sentences.en: He squashed the insect with the heel of his foot.
sentences.zh: 他用脚后跟压碎了这只昆虫。

sentences.en: This is the first time I've ever squashed a cockroach.
sentences.zh: 这是我第一次压碎蟑螂。

sentences.en: Despite their popularity, cricket and squash are not Olympic sports.
sentences.zh: 尽管软式网球和壁球很受欢迎，但它们并不是奥运会项目。
